title: Make skill artifact signing real and bind it to content (VC-201-085)
goal: VC-201-085 refuted: skill_sign is signer:name@version with no key material — forgeable by anyone for any trusted signer; the signature covers only name+version so signed reflexes/prompts/capabilities can be swapped wholesale and still verify; fixture tests are never run (verdict trusts a caller-supplied bool); and import_skill has no production caller. Evidence: crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_085_mastery.rs.
